options: And I ask You by Your names by which I have called upon You, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as I have described, of what none knows except You, and to have mercy on me, accept my repentance, and grant me well-being from every trial and affliction, and to forgive me and my parents and have mercy on the believing men and women and Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as the sand and pebbles in the east and west of the earth, and as many as what You created of jinn and humans, and as many as their breaths, their utterances, and their glances, and as many as the flight of jinn and angels, and as many as the birds, crawling creatures, and wild beasts in the east and west of the earth, and as many as the living and the dead, and as many as what night has darkened over and day has shone upon, and as many as those who walk on two legs and those who walk on four, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection.

And upon all the prophets and messengers, that You send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your Prophet, as many as You created before the sky was built, the mountains anchored, the springs made to burst forth, the rivers made to pour down, the sun made to shine by day, the moon made luminous, and the stars made radiant. You were where You were; none knows where You were except You alone, with no partner.

The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said: whoever reads this blessing a single time, Allah will record for him the reward of an accepted pilgrimage. So Allah, the Exalted, says: O My angels, this is a servant among My servants who has multiplied blessings upon My beloved Muhammad; so by My might and My majesty, I shall grant him, for every letter he has blessed with, a palace in Paradise, the light of his face like the moon on the night it is full, and his hand in the hand of My beloved Muhammad.

And I ask You by Your Name which, when called upon by it, You answer, and when asked by it, You give; and I ask You by Your Name which You placed upon the night and it grew dark, and upon the day and it shone with light, and upon the heavens and they became lifted, and upon the earth and it became settled, and upon the mountains and they became anchored, and upon the difficult and it became easy, and upon the water of the sky and it was poured, and upon the clouds and they rained.
exercises.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada man salla 'alayhi minal-jinni wal-insi wal-mala'ikah, wa 'adada man yusalli 'alayhi wa 'adada man lam yusalli 'alayh, kama yajibu an yusalla 'alayhi wa kama yambaghi an yusalla 'alayh, hatta la yabqa shay'un minas-salati 'alayh, wa salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin fil-awwalina wa fil-akhirina wa fil-mala'il-a'la ila yawmid-din, ma sha'allahu la quwwata illa billahil-'aliyyil-'azim.

exercises.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ، وَعَدَدَ مَنْ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ وَعَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، كَمَا يَجِبُ أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَكَمَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ، حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى شَيْءٌ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْأَوَّلِينَ وَفِي الْآخِرِينَ وَفِي الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ، مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ.
options: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as those among jinn, humans, and angels who have sent blessings upon him, and as many as those who send blessings upon him and as many as those who do not, as blessings are due upon him and as it is fitting that blessings be sent upon him, until nothing of blessing upon him remains, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the first and among the last and in the Highest Assembly until the Day of Judgment. What Allah wills; there is no power except in Allah, the Most High, the Exalted.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as the sand and pebbles in the east and west of the earth, and as many as what You created of jinn and humans, and as many as their breaths, their utterances, and their glances, and as many as the flight of jinn and angels, and as many as the birds, crawling creatures, and wild beasts in the east and west of the earth, and as many as the living and the dead, and as many as what night has darkened over and day has shone upon, and as many as those who walk on two legs and those who walk on four, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection.

And by the names by which our master Zakariya called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Yahya called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Armiya called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Sha'ya called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Ilyas called upon You, peace be upon him.

And by the names by which our master Harun called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Shu'ayb called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Isma'il called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Dawud called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Sulayman called upon You, peace be upon him.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ عِلْمِكَ وَعَدَدَ حِلْمِكَ وَعَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَاهُ اللَّوْحُ الْمَحْفُوظُ مِنْ عِلْمِكَ، وَعَدَدَ مَا جَرَى بِهِ الْقَلَمُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ عِنْدَكَ، وَمِلْءَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ وَمِلْءَ أَرْضِكَ وَمِلْءَ مَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
pairs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as Your knowledge, and as many as Your forbearance, and as many as the Preserved Tablet has recorded of Your knowledge, and as many as the Pen has recorded in the Mother of the Book with You, and filling Your heavens and filling Your earth and filling what You will create from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ صُفُوفِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَتَسْبِيحِهِمْ وَتَقْدِيسِهِمْ وَتَمْجِيدِهِمْ وَتَكْبِيرِهِمْ وَتَهْلِيلِهِمْ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَعَدَدَ السَّحَابِ الْجَارِيَةِ وَالرِّيَاحِ الذَّارِيَةِ، وَعَدَدَ كُلِّ قَطْرَةٍ تَقْطُرُ مِنْ سَمَاوَاتِكَ إِلَى أَرْضِكَ، وَعَدَدَ مَا هَبَّتْ بِهِ الرِّيَاحُ وَتَحَرَّكَتْ بِهِ الْأَشْجَارُ وَالْأَوْرَاقُ وَالزُّرُوعُ، وَعَدَدَ الْقَطْرِ وَالْمَطَرِ وَالنَّبَاتِ، وَعَدَدَ النُّجُومِ فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَعَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي بِحَارِكَ السَّبْعَةِ مِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as the ranks of the angels and their glorification, their sanctification, their magnification, their exaltation, and their declaration of Your Oneness from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, and as many as the flowing clouds and the scattering winds, and as many as every drop that falls from Your heavens to Your earth, and as many as what the winds have stirred and the trees, leaves, and crops have moved by, and as many as the drops, the rain, and the vegetation, and as many as the stars in the sky, and as many as what You created in Your seven seas which none knows except You.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرَّمْلِ وَالْحَصَى فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا، وَعَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ، وَعَدَدَ أَنْفَاسِهِمْ وَأَلْفَاظِهِمْ وَلَحَظَاتِهِمْ، وَعَدَدَ طَيَرَانِ الْجِنِّ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ، وَعَدَدَ الطُّيُورِ وَالْهَوَامِّ وَالْوُحُوشِ فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا، وَعَدَدَ الْأَحْيَاءِ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ، وَعَدَدَ مَا أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَشْرَقَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ، وَعَدَدَ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَى رِجْلَيْنِ وَمَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَى أَرْبَعٍ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
pairs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as the sand and pebbles in the east and west of the earth, and as many as what You created of jinn and humans, and as many as their breaths, their utterances, and their glances, and as many as the flight of jinn and angels, and as many as the birds, crawling creatures, and wild beasts in the east and west of the earth, and as many as the living and the dead, and as many as what night has darkened over and day has shone upon, and as many as those who walk on two legs and those who walk on four, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection.

exercises.prompt: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآتِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ.
options: O Allah, my Lord, convey to him from us the best of greetings, and reward him on our behalf with the best that You have rewarded any prophet on behalf of his nation, O Lord of the worlds.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family, as many as Your knowledge encompasses and Your Book has counted and Your angels have witnessed, an enduring blessing that endures as long as the dominion of Allah endures.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, and the elevated rank, and raise him to the Praised Station which You promised him. Indeed You do not break Your promise.

O Allah, gladden us with him in the courtyards of Resurrection, and make him for us a guide to the Garden of Bliss without hardship, without difficulty, and without a searching reckoning, and make him well-disposed toward us, and do not make him angry with us.
exercises.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin wa atihil-wasilata wal-fadhilata wad-darajatar-rafi'ata, wab'athul-maqamal-mahmudal-ladhi wa'adtahu, innaka la tukhliful-mi'ad.

exercises.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآتِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ.
options: O Allah, magnify his standing, make manifest his proof, make clear his argument, make plain his excellence, and accept his intercession for his nation, and employ us by his way, O Lord of the worlds, O Lord of the Great Throne. O Allah, my Lord, gather us in his company and beneath his banner, and give us to drink from his cup, and benefit us through love of him. Amen, O Lord of the worlds.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family, as many as Your knowledge encompasses and Your Book has counted and Your angels have witnessed, an enduring blessing that endures as long as the dominion of Allah endures.

And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the mountains, the sands, and the pebbles, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the trees and their leaves and the clods of earth and their weights, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as every year and what You create in it and what dies in it, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You create every day and what dies in it until the Day of Resurrection.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, and the elevated rank, and raise him to the Praised Station which You promised him. Indeed You do not break Your promise.

exercises.prompt: اللَّهُمَّ عَظِّمْ شَأْنَهُ وَبَيِّنْ بُرْهَانَهُ وَأَبْلِجْ حُجَّتَهُ وَبَيِّنْ فَضِيلَتَهُ وَتَقَبَّلْ شَفَاعَتَهُ فِي أُمَّتِهِ وَاسْتَعْمِلْنَا بِسُنَّتِهِ، يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، يَا رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ. اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبِّ احْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ وَتَحْتَ لِوَائِهِ وَاسْقِنَا بِكَأْسِهِ وَانْفَعْنَا بِمَحَبَّتِهِ آمِينَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
options: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your knowledge, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your forbearance, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your words, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your favor, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your generosity, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your heavens, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your earth.

O Allah, magnify his standing, make manifest his proof, make clear his argument, make plain his excellence, and accept his intercession for his nation, and employ us by his way, O Lord of the worlds, O Lord of the Great Throne. O Allah, my Lord, gather us in his company and beneath his banner, and give us to drink from his cup, and benefit us through love of him. Amen, O Lord of the worlds.

And upon the earth and it became settled, and upon the seas and they burst forth, and upon the springs and they gushed, and upon the clouds and they rained. And I ask You by the names written on the brow of our master Jibril, peace be upon him, and by the names written on the brow of our master Israfil, peace be upon him, and upon all the angels, and I ask You by the names written around the Throne and by the names written around the Chair.

And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as what You created in Your seven heavens, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as what You will create in them until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the drops of rain and every drop that has fallen from Your sky to Your earth from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.
exercises.translit: Allahumma 'azzim sha'nahu wa bayyin burhanahu wa ablij hujjatahu wa bayyin fadhilatahu wa taqabbal shafa'atahu fi ummatihi wasta'milna bi-sunnatihi, ya Rabbal-'alamin, ya Rabbal-'arshil-'azim. Allahumma ya Rabbi-hshurna fi zumratihi wa tahta liwa'ihi wasqina bika'sihi wanfa'na bi-mahabbatihi amin ya Rabbal-'alamin.

exercises.native: اللَّهُمَّ عَظِّمْ شَأْنَهُ وَبَيِّنْ بُرْهَانَهُ وَأَبْلِجْ حُجَّتَهُ وَبَيِّنْ فَضِيلَتَهُ وَتَقَبَّلْ شَفَاعَتَهُ فِي أُمَّتِهِ وَاسْتَعْمِلْنَا بِسُنَّتِهِ، يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، يَا رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ. اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبِّ احْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ وَتَحْتَ لِوَائِهِ وَاسْقِنَا بِكَأْسِهِ وَانْفَعْنَا بِمَحَبَّتِهِ آمِينَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
options: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the clouds flowing between the sky and the earth and the waters they rain down, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the winds made subservient in the east and west of the earth, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the stars of the sky, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You created in Your seas of fish, creatures, waters, sands, and other than that.

O Allah, I ask You by the Great Names, those I know of them and those I do not know, and by the names by which You have named Yourself, those I know of them and those I do not know, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your prophet, and Your messenger, as many as You created before the sky was built, the earth spread out, the mountains anchored, the springs made to burst forth, the rivers made to pour down, the sun made to rise, the moon made luminous, the stars made radiant, the seas made to flow, and the trees made to bear fruit.

O Allah, magnify his standing, make manifest his proof, make clear his argument, make plain his excellence, and accept his intercession for his nation, and employ us by his way, O Lord of the worlds, O Lord of the Great Throne. O Allah, my Lord, gather us in his company and beneath his banner, and give us to drink from his cup, and benefit us through love of him. Amen, O Lord of the worlds.

I ask You by what Your Chair bears of Your greatness, Your majesty, Your splendor, Your power, and Your dominion, and by the right of Your treasured, hidden, purified Names which none of Your creation has been shown, and by the right of the Name which You placed upon the night and it grew dark, and upon the day and it shone with light, and upon the heavens and they became lifted.

exercises.prompt: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبِّ بَلِّغْهُ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ السَّلَامِ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا جَازَيْتَ بِهِ نَبِيًّا عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ، يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
options: And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as what You created in Your seven heavens, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as what You will create in them until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the drops of rain and every drop that has fallen from Your sky to Your earth from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.
And to forgive me my sins and cover my faults, O Bestower, O Forgiver, and to bless me with looking upon Your noble Face among the beloved ones on the Day of Increase and Reward.
O Allah, my Lord, convey to him from us the best of greetings, and reward him on our behalf with the best that You have rewarded any prophet on behalf of his nation, O Lord of the worlds.

O Allah, O You who granted our master Adam our master Sheeth, and granted our master Ibrahim our master Isma'il and our master Ishaq, and returned our master Yusuf to our master Ya'qub, and O You who removed the affliction from our master Ayyub.
exercises.translit: Allahumma ya Rabbi balligh-hu 'anna afdhalas-salam, wajzihi 'anna afdhala ma jazayta bihi nabiyyan 'an ummatihi, ya Rabbal-'alamin.

exercises.native: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبِّ بَلِّغْهُ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ السَّلَامِ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا جَازَيْتَ بِهِ نَبِيًّا عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ، يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
options: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim, and bless our master Muhammad just as You blessed our master Ibrahim. O Allah, place Your blessings and Your benedictions upon our master Muhammad just as You placed them upon our master Ibrahim and upon the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
O Allah, my Lord, convey to him from us the best of greetings, and reward him on our behalf with the best that You have rewarded any prophet on behalf of his nation, O Lord of the worlds.

And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as those who praise You, thank You, declare Your Oneness, and glorify You, and who witness that You are Allah, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many times as You and Your angels have blessed him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as those of Your creation who have blessed him and as many as those of Your creation who have not.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, and the elevated rank, and raise him to the Praised Station which You promised him. Indeed You do not break Your promise.

exercises.prompt: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبِّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي وَتَتُوبَ عَلَيَّ وَتُعَافِيَنِي مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْبَلَاءِ وَالْبَلْوَى الْخَارِجِ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ وَالنَّازِلِ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. بِرَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ.
options: O Allah, magnify his standing, make manifest his proof, make clear his argument, make plain his excellence, and accept his intercession for his nation, and employ us by his way, O Lord of the worlds, O Lord of the Great Throne. O Allah, my Lord, gather us in his company and beneath his banner, and give us to drink from his cup, and benefit us through love of him. Amen, O Lord of the worlds.
And forgive us and our parents and all the Muslims, the living among them and the dead, and the last of our prayer is that all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

O Allah, my Lord, I ask You to forgive me, have mercy on me, accept my repentance, and grant me well-being from every trial and affliction that comes from the earth or descends from the sky, indeed You have power over all things, by Your mercy; and to forgive the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead.

O Allah, I ask You, for indeed You are my Master, my Lord, my Protector, my confidence, and my hope, I ask You by the sanctity of the sacred month, the sacred city, the sacred site, and the grave of Your Prophet, peace be upon him, to grant me of the good that none knows except You, and to turn away from me the evil that none knows except You.
exercises.translit: Allahumma ya Rabbi inni as'aluka an taghfira li wa tarhamani wa tatuba 'alayya wa tu'afiyani min jami'il-bala'i wal-balwal-khariji minal-ardhi wan-nazili minas-sama', innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, bi-rahmatika, wa an taghfira lil-mu'minina wal-mu'minati wal-muslimina wal-muslimatil-ahya'i minhum wal-amwat.

exercises.native: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبِّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي وَتَتُوبَ عَلَيَّ وَتُعَافِيَنِي مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْبَلَاءِ وَالْبَلْوَى الْخَارِجِ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ وَالنَّازِلِ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. بِرَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ.
options: O Allah, my Lord, I ask You to forgive me, have mercy on me, accept my repentance, and grant me well-being from every trial and affliction that comes from the earth or descends from the sky, indeed You have power over all things, by Your mercy; and to forgive the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead.

And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as my words, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the verses of the Quran and its letters, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as those who bless him and as many as those who do not, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family filling Your earth, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the Pen has recorded in the Mother of the Book.
And forgive us and our parents and all the Muslims, the living among them and the dead, and the last of our prayer is that all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as what You created in Your seven heavens, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as what You will create in them until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the drops of rain and every drop that has fallen from Your sky to Your earth from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآتِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, and the elevated rank, and raise him to the Praised Station which You promised him. Indeed You do not break Your promise.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ عَظِّمْ شَأْنَهُ وَبَيِّنْ بُرْهَانَهُ وَأَبْلِجْ حُجَّتَهُ وَبَيِّنْ فَضِيلَتَهُ وَتَقَبَّلْ شَفَاعَتَهُ فِي أُمَّتِهِ وَاسْتَعْمِلْنَا بِسُنَّتِهِ، يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، يَا رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ. اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبِّ احْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ وَتَحْتَ لِوَائِهِ وَاسْقِنَا بِكَأْسِهِ وَانْفَعْنَا بِمَحَبَّتِهِ آمِينَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, magnify his standing, make manifest his proof, make clear his argument, make plain his excellence, and accept his intercession for his nation, and employ us by his way, O Lord of the worlds, O Lord of the Great Throne. O Allah, my Lord, gather us in his company and beneath his banner, and give us to drink from his cup, and benefit us through love of him. Amen, O Lord of the worlds.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبِّ بَلِّغْهُ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ السَّلَامِ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا جَازَيْتَ بِهِ نَبِيًّا عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ، يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, my Lord, convey to him from us the best of greetings, and reward him on our behalf with the best that You have rewarded any prophet on behalf of his nation, O Lord of the worlds.

exercises.prompt: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ الْأَرْوَاحِ وَالْأَجْسَادِ الْبَالِيَةِ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِطَاعَةِ الْأَرْوَاحِ الرَّاجِعَةِ إِلَى أَجْسَادِهَا، وَبِطَاعَةِ الْأَجْسَادِ الْمُلْتَئِمَةِ بِعُرُوقِهَا بِكَلِمَاتِكَ النَّافِذَةِ فِيهِمْ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ نُورًا فِي بَصَرِي، وَذِكْرَكَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ عَلَى لِسَانِي، وَعَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَارْزُقْنِي.
options: O Allah, Lord of the souls and the decayed bodies, I ask You by the obedience of the souls returning to their bodies, and by the obedience of the bodies rejoined with their veins by Your words penetrating within them, to place light in my sight, and Your remembrance upon my tongue by night and by day, and grant me righteous deeds.

O Allah, gladden us with him in the courtyards of Resurrection, and make him for us a guide to the Garden of Bliss without hardship, without difficulty, and without a searching reckoning, and make him well-disposed toward us, and do not make him angry with us.

O Allah, my Lord, I ask You to forgive me, have mercy on me, accept my repentance, and grant me well-being from every trial and affliction that comes from the earth or descends from the sky, indeed You have power over all things, by Your mercy; and to forgive the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead.

And upon the earth and it became settled, and upon the seas and they burst forth, and upon the springs and they gushed, and upon the clouds and they rained. And I ask You by the names written on the brow of our master Jibril, peace be upon him, and by the names written on the brow of our master Israfil, peace be upon him, and upon all the angels, and I ask You by the names written around the Throne and by the names written around the Chair.
exercises.translit: Allahumma Rabbal-arwahi wal-ajsadil-baliyah, as'aluka bi-ta'atil-arwahir-raji'ati ila ajsadiha, wa bi-ta'atil-ajsadil-multa'imati bi-'uruqiha bi-kalimatikan-nafidhati fihim, an taj'ala nuran fi basari, wa dhikraka bil-layli wan-nahari 'ala lisani, wa 'amalan salihan farzuqni.

options: And I ask You, O Allah, by the right of what I have sworn to You by, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as You created before the sky was built, the earth spread out, the mountains raised, the springs made to burst forth, the seas made subservient, the rivers made to pour down, the sun made to shine, the moon made luminous, and the star made radiant, and none knows where You are except You.

O Allah, O You who granted our master Adam our master Sheeth, and granted our master Ibrahim our master Isma'il and our master Ishaq, and returned our master Yusuf to our master Ya'qub, and O You who removed the affliction from our master Ayyub.

O Allah, Lord of the souls and the decayed bodies, I ask You by the obedience of the souls returning to their bodies, and by the obedience of the bodies rejoined with their veins by Your words penetrating within them, to place light in my sight, and Your remembrance upon my tongue by night and by day, and grant me righteous deeds.

And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the mountains, the sands, and the pebbles, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the trees and their leaves and the clods of earth and their weights, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as every year and what You create in it and what dies in it, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You create every day and what dies in it until the Day of Resurrection.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ الْأَرْوَاحِ وَالْأَجْسَادِ الْبَالِيَةِ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِطَاعَةِ الْأَرْوَاحِ الرَّاجِعَةِ إِلَى أَجْسَادِهَا، وَبِطَاعَةِ الْأَجْسَادِ الْمُلْتَئِمَةِ بِعُرُوقِهَا بِكَلِمَاتِكَ النَّافِذَةِ فِيهِمْ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ نُورًا فِي بَصَرِي، وَذِكْرَكَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ عَلَى لِسَانِي، وَعَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَارْزُقْنِي.
pairs.en: O Allah, Lord of the souls and the decayed bodies, I ask You by the obedience of the souls returning to their bodies, and by the obedience of the bodies rejoined with their veins by Your words penetrating within them, to place light in my sight, and Your remembrance upon my tongue by night and by day, and grant me righteous deeds.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ. اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَبَرَكَاتِكَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا جَعَلْتَهَا عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
pairs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim, and bless our master Muhammad just as You blessed our master Ibrahim. O Allah, place Your blessings and Your benedictions upon our master Muhammad just as You placed them upon our master Ibrahim and upon the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ.
pairs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant and Your messenger, and send blessings upon the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women.

O Allah, gladden us with him in the courtyards of Resurrection, and make him for us a guide to the Garden of Bliss without hardship, without difficulty, and without a searching reckoning, and make him well-disposed toward us, and do not make him angry with us.

options: And to accept from me my deeds, and to pardon what Your knowledge encompasses of my errors, my forgetfulness, and my slips, and to bring me to the utmost of my hope in visiting his grave and greeting him and his two companions with peace, by Your grace, Your favor, Your generosity, and Your bounty, O Kind, O Merciful, O Protector.

And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You created in Your seven heavens of angels, and as many as what You created in Your earth of jinn, humans, and other than them of wild beasts and birds, and as many as what the Pen has recorded in the knowledge of Your unseen and what it will record until the Day of Resurrection, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the drops and the rain.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ عِلْمِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ حِلْمِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كَلِمَاتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ جُودِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَرْضِكَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your knowledge, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your forbearance, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your words, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your favor, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your generosity, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your heavens, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your earth.

pairs.native: وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي سَبْعِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ، وَعَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي أَرْضِكَ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ وَغَيْرِهِمَا مِنَ الْوَحْشِ وَالطَّيْرِ وَغَيْرِهِمَا، وَعَدَدَ مَا جَرَى بِهِ الْقَلَمُ فِي عِلْمِ غَيْبِكَ وَمَا يَجْرِي بِهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الْقَطْرِ وَالْمَطَرِ.
pairs.en: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You created in Your seven heavens of angels, and as many as what You created in Your earth of jinn, humans, and other than them of wild beasts and birds, and as many as what the Pen has recorded in the knowledge of Your unseen and what it will record until the Day of Resurrection, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the drops and the rain.

pairs.native: وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ يَحْمَدُكَ وَيَشْكُرُكَ وَيُهَلِّلُكَ وَيُمَجِّدُكَ وَيَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْتَ وَمَلَائِكَتُكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَعَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ.
pairs.en: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as those who praise You, thank You, declare Your Oneness, and glorify You, and who witness that You are Allah, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many times as You and Your angels have blessed him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as those of Your creation who have blessed him and as many as those of Your creation who have not.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ السَّحَابِ الْجَارِيَةِ بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا تُمْطِرُ مِنَ الْمِيَاهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرِّيَاحِ الْمُسَخَّرَاتِ فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ نُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي بِحَارِكَ مِنَ الْحِيتَانِ وَالدَّوَابِّ وَالْمِيَاهِ وَالرِّمَالِ وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the clouds flowing between the sky and the earth and the waters they rain down, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the winds made subservient in the east and west of the earth, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the stars of the sky, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You created in Your seas of fish, creatures, waters, sands, and other than that.

pairs.native: وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النَّبَاتِ وَالْحَصَى، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النَّمْلِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الْمِيَاهِ الْعَذْبَةِ وَالْمِيَاهِ الْمِلْحَةِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ نِعْمَتِكَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَى قَدْرِ مَا تُحِبُّهُ وَتَرْضَاهُ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَى قَدْرِ مَا يُحِبُّكَ وَيَرْضَاكَ.
pairs.en: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the vegetation and the pebbles, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the ants, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the fresh waters and the salty waters, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your favor upon all Your creation, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad to the extent that You love and are pleased with him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad to the extent that he loves You and is pleased with You.

pairs.native: وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَبَدَ الْآبِدِينَ، وَأَنْزِلْهُ الْمَنْزِلَ الْمُقَرَّبَ عِنْدَكَ، وَآتِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالشَّفَاعَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، وَابْعَثِ الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ.
pairs.en: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad forever and ever, and settle him in the station nearest to You, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, the intercession, and the elevated rank, and raise him to the Praised Station which You promised him. Indeed You do not break Your promise.

exercises.prompt: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّكَ مَالِكِي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلَايَ وَثِقَتِي وَرَجَائِي، أَسْأَلُكَ بِحُرْمَةِ الشَّهْرِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْبَلَدِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ وَقَبْرِ نَبِيِّكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، أَنْ تَهَبَ لِي مِنَ الْخَيْرِ مَا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَتَصْرِفَ عَنِّي مِنَ السُّوءِ مَا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
options: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You created in Your seven heavens of angels, and as many as what You created in Your earth of jinn, humans, and other than them of wild beasts and birds, and as many as what the Pen has recorded in the knowledge of Your unseen and what it will record until the Day of Resurrection, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the drops and the rain.

O Allah, I ask You, for indeed You are my Master, my Lord, my Protector, my confidence, and my hope, I ask You by the sanctity of the sacred month, the sacred city, the sacred site, and the grave of Your Prophet, peace be upon him, to grant me of the good that none knows except You, and to turn away from me the evil that none knows except You.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim, and bless our master Muhammad just as You blessed our master Ibrahim. O Allah, place Your blessings and Your benedictions upon our master Muhammad just as You placed them upon our master Ibrahim and upon the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

O Allah, I ask You by the Great Names, those I know of them and those I do not know, and by the names by which You have named Yourself, those I know of them and those I do not know, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your prophet, and Your messenger, as many as You created before the sky was built, the earth spread out, the mountains anchored, the springs made to burst forth, the rivers made to pour down, the sun made to rise, the moon made luminous, the stars made radiant, the seas made to flow, and the trees made to bear fruit.
exercises.translit: Allahumma inni as'aluka bi-annaka maliki wa sayyidi wa mawlaya wa thiqati wa raja'i, as'aluka bi-hurmatish-shahril-harami wal-baladil-harami wal-mash'aril-harami wa qabri nabiyyika 'alayhis-salam, an tahaba li minal-khayri ma la ya'lamu 'ilmahu illa ant, wa tasrifa 'anni minas-su'i ma la ya'lamu 'ilmahu illa ant.

exercises.native: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّكَ مَالِكِي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلَايَ وَثِقَتِي وَرَجَائِي، أَسْأَلُكَ بِحُرْمَةِ الشَّهْرِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْبَلَدِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ وَقَبْرِ نَبِيِّكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، أَنْ تَهَبَ لِي مِنَ الْخَيْرِ مَا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَتَصْرِفَ عَنِّي مِنَ السُّوءِ مَا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
options: And I ask You by the names by which our master Adam called upon You, peace be upon him, and by which our master Nuh, our master Salih, our master Ya'qub, our master Yusuf, our master Yunus, our master Musa, our master Harun, and our master Shu'ayb called upon You, peace be upon them.

O Allah, I ask You, for indeed You are my Master, my Lord, my Protector, my confidence, and my hope, I ask You by the sanctity of the sacred month, the sacred city, the sacred site, and the grave of Your Prophet, peace be upon him, to grant me of the good that none knows except You, and to turn away from me the evil that none knows except You.

O Allah, magnify his standing, make manifest his proof, make clear his argument, make plain his excellence, and accept his intercession for his nation, and employ us by his way, O Lord of the worlds, O Lord of the Great Throne. O Allah, my Lord, gather us in his company and beneath his banner, and give us to drink from his cup, and benefit us through love of him. Amen, O Lord of the worlds.
And forgive us and our parents and all the Muslims, the living among them and the dead, and the last of our prayer is that all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

exercises.prompt: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ وَهَبَ لِسَيِّدِنَا آدَمَ سَيِّدَنَا شِيثًا، وَلِسَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ سَيِّدَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَسَيِّدَنَا إِسْحَاقَ، وَرَدَّ سَيِّدَنَا يُوسُفَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا يَعْقُوبَ، وَيَا مَنْ كَشَفَ الْبَلَاءَ عَنْ سَيِّدِنَا أَيُّوبَ.
options: And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as my words, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the verses of the Quran and its letters, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as those who bless him and as many as those who do not, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family filling Your earth, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the Pen has recorded in the Mother of the Book.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the clouds flowing between the sky and the earth and the waters they rain down, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the winds made subservient in the east and west of the earth, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the stars of the sky, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You created in Your seas of fish, creatures, waters, sands, and other than that.
And I ask You by Your Greatest Name by which You have named Yourself, and I ask You by the right of all Your Names, those I know of them and those I do not know.

O Allah, O You who granted our master Adam our master Sheeth, and granted our master Ibrahim our master Isma'il and our master Ishaq, and returned our master Yusuf to our master Ya'qub, and O You who removed the affliction from our master Ayyub.
exercises.translit: Allahumma ya man wahaba li-Sayyidina Adama Sayyidana Shithan, wa li-Sayyidina Ibrahima Sayyidana Isma'ila wa Sayyidana Ishaq, wa radda Sayyidana Yusufa 'ala Sayyidina Ya'qub, wa ya man kashafal-bala'a 'an Sayyidina Ayyub.

O Allah, O You who granted our master Adam our master Sheeth, and granted our master Ibrahim our master Isma'il and our master Ishaq, and returned our master Yusuf to our master Ya'qub, and O You who removed the affliction from our master Ayyub.

And to reward him on my behalf and on behalf of everyone who believed in him and followed him among the Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead, with the best, most complete, and most comprehensive reward You have given anyone of Your creation, O Strong, O Mighty, O Most High.

O Allah, I ask You, for indeed You are my Master, my Lord, my Protector, my confidence, and my hope, I ask You by the sanctity of the sacred month, the sacred city, the sacred site, and the grave of Your Prophet, peace be upon him, to grant me of the good that none knows except You, and to turn away from me the evil that none knows except You.

exercises.prompt: وَيَا مَنْ رَدَّ مُوسَى إِلَى أُمِّهِ، وَيَا زَائِدَ سَيِّدِنَا الْخَضِرِ فِي عِلْمِهِ، وَيَا مَنْ وَهَبَ لِسَيِّدِنَا دَاوُدَ سَيِّدَنَا سُلَيْمَانَ، وَلِسَيِّدِنَا زَكَرِيَّا سَيِّدَنَا يَحْيَى، وَلِسَيِّدَتِنَا مَرْيَمَ سَيِّدَنَا عِيسَى، وَيَا حَافِظَ ابْنَةِ سَيِّدِنَا شُعَيْبٍ.
options: I ask You to send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon all the prophets and messengers, and O You who granted our master Muhammad, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, intercession and the elevated rank, to forgive me my sins and cover all my faults and grant me refuge from the Fire.
And I ask You by Your Greatest Name by which You have named Yourself, and I ask You by the right of all Your Names, those I know of them and those I do not know.

And O You who returned Musa to his mother, and O You who increased our master al-Khidr in his knowledge, and O You who granted our master Dawud our master Sulayman, and our master Zakariya our master Yahya, and our lady Maryam our master 'Isa, and O Protector of the daughter of our master Shu'ayb.

O Allah, I ask You by the Great Names, those I know of them and those I do not know, and by the names by which You have named Yourself, those I know of them and those I do not know, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your prophet, and Your messenger, as many as You created before the sky was built, the earth spread out, the mountains anchored, the springs made to burst forth, the rivers made to pour down, the sun made to rise, the moon made luminous, the stars made radiant, the seas made to flow, and the trees made to bear fruit.
exercises.translit: Wa ya man radda Musa ila ummihi, wa ya za'ida Sayyidinal-Khidhri fi 'ilmihi, wa ya man wahaba li-Sayyidina Dawuda Sayyidana Sulayman, wa li-Sayyidina Zakariyya Sayyidana Yahya, wa li-Sayyidatina Maryama Sayyidana 'Isa, wa ya hafiza ibnati Sayyidina Shu'ayb.

And O You who returned Musa to his mother, and O You who increased our master al-Khidr in his knowledge, and O You who granted our master Dawud our master Sulayman, and our master Zakariya our master Yahya, and our lady Maryam our master 'Isa, and O Protector of the daughter of our master Shu'ayb.

O Allah, gladden us with him in the courtyards of Resurrection, and make him for us a guide to the Garden of Bliss without hardship, without difficulty, and without a searching reckoning, and make him well-disposed toward us, and do not make him angry with us.

And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the mountains, the sands, and the pebbles, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the trees and their leaves and the clods of earth and their weights, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as every year and what You create in it and what dies in it, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You create every day and what dies in it until the Day of Resurrection.

exercises.prompt: أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَيَا مَنْ وَهَبَ لِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الشَّفَاعَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَتَسْتُرَ عَلَيَّ عُيُوبِي كُلَّهَا وَتُجِيرَنِي مِنَ النَّارِ.
options: O Allah, O You who granted our master Adam our master Sheeth, and granted our master Ibrahim our master Isma'il and our master Ishaq, and returned our master Yusuf to our master Ya'qub, and O You who removed the affliction from our master Ayyub.
So I ask You, O Allah, O Allah, O Living, O Eternal, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor: there is no god except You. Glory be to You! Surely I have been a wrong-doer.

I ask You to send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon all the prophets and messengers, and O You who granted our master Muhammad, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, intercession and the elevated rank, to forgive me my sins and cover all my faults and grant me refuge from the Fire.

O Allah, I ask You by the Great Names, those I know of them and those I do not know, and by the names by which You have named Yourself, those I know of them and those I do not know, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your prophet, and Your messenger, as many as You created before the sky was built, the earth spread out, the mountains anchored, the springs made to burst forth, the rivers made to pour down, the sun made to rise, the moon made luminous, the stars made radiant, the seas made to flow, and the trees made to bear fruit.
exercises.translit: As'aluka an tusalliya 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala jami'in-nabiyyina wal-mursalin, wa ya man wahaba li-Sayyidina Muhammadin sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallamash-shafa'ata wad-darajatar-rafi'ah, an taghfira li dhunubi wa tastura 'alayya 'uyubi kullaha wa tujirani minan-nar.

I ask You to grant me and everyone who loves him and follows him his intercession and his companionship on the Day of Reckoning.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّكَ مَالِكِي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلَايَ وَثِقَتِي وَرَجَائِي، أَسْأَلُكَ بِحُرْمَةِ الشَّهْرِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْبَلَدِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ وَقَبْرِ نَبِيِّكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، أَنْ تَهَبَ لِي مِنَ الْخَيْرِ مَا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَتَصْرِفَ عَنِّي مِنَ السُّوءِ مَا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, I ask You, for indeed You are my Master, my Lord, my Protector, my confidence, and my hope, I ask You by the sanctity of the sacred month, the sacred city, the sacred site, and the grave of Your Prophet, peace be upon him, to grant me of the good that none knows except You, and to turn away from me the evil that none knows except You.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ وَهَبَ لِسَيِّدِنَا آدَمَ سَيِّدَنَا شِيثًا، وَلِسَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ سَيِّدَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَسَيِّدَنَا إِسْحَاقَ، وَرَدَّ سَيِّدَنَا يُوسُفَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا يَعْقُوبَ، وَيَا مَنْ كَشَفَ الْبَلَاءَ عَنْ سَيِّدِنَا أَيُّوبَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, O You who granted our master Adam our master Sheeth, and granted our master Ibrahim our master Isma'il and our master Ishaq, and returned our master Yusuf to our master Ya'qub, and O You who removed the affliction from our master Ayyub.

pairs.native: وَيَا مَنْ رَدَّ مُوسَى إِلَى أُمِّهِ، وَيَا زَائِدَ سَيِّدِنَا الْخَضِرِ فِي عِلْمِهِ، وَيَا مَنْ وَهَبَ لِسَيِّدِنَا دَاوُدَ سَيِّدَنَا سُلَيْمَانَ، وَلِسَيِّدِنَا زَكَرِيَّا سَيِّدَنَا يَحْيَى، وَلِسَيِّدَتِنَا مَرْيَمَ سَيِّدَنَا عِيسَى، وَيَا حَافِظَ ابْنَةِ سَيِّدِنَا شُعَيْبٍ.
pairs.en: And O You who returned Musa to his mother, and O You who increased our master al-Khidr in his knowledge, and O You who granted our master Dawud our master Sulayman, and our master Zakariya our master Yahya, and our lady Maryam our master 'Isa, and O Protector of the daughter of our master Shu'ayb.

lessons.title: Joy on the Day of Resurrection
lessons.description: Joy on the Day of Resurrection

exercises.prompt: اللَّهُمَّ فَرِّحْنَا بِهِ فِي عَرَصَاتِ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ لَنَا دَلِيلًا إِلَى جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ بِلَا مَؤُونَةٍ وَلَا مَشَقَّةٍ وَلَا مُنَاقَشَةِ الْحِسَابِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ مُقْبِلًا عَلَيْنَا وَلَا تَجْعَلْهُ غَاضِبًا عَلَيْنَا.
options: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad forever and ever, and settle him in the station nearest to You, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, the intercession, and the elevated rank, and raise him to the Praised Station which You promised him. Indeed You do not break Your promise.

And upon the earth and it became settled, and upon the seas and they burst forth, and upon the springs and they gushed, and upon the clouds and they rained. And I ask You by the names written on the brow of our master Jibril, peace be upon him, and by the names written on the brow of our master Israfil, peace be upon him, and upon all the angels, and I ask You by the names written around the Throne and by the names written around the Chair.

And to accept from me my deeds, and to pardon what Your knowledge encompasses of my errors, my forgetfulness, and my slips, and to bring me to the utmost of my hope in visiting his grave and greeting him and his two companions with peace, by Your grace, Your favor, Your generosity, and Your bounty, O Kind, O Merciful, O Protector.

O Allah, gladden us with him in the courtyards of Resurrection, and make him for us a guide to the Garden of Bliss without hardship, without difficulty, and without a searching reckoning, and make him well-disposed toward us, and do not make him angry with us.
exercises.translit: Allahumma farrihna bihi fi 'arasatil-qiyamah, waj'alhu lana dalilan ila jannatin-na'imi bila mu'natin wa la mashaqqatin wa la munaqashatil-hisab, waj'alhu muqbilan 'alayna wa la taj'alhu ghadhiban 'alayna.

exercises.native: اللَّهُمَّ فَرِّحْنَا بِهِ فِي عَرَصَاتِ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ لَنَا دَلِيلًا إِلَى جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ بِلَا مَؤُونَةٍ وَلَا مَشَقَّةٍ وَلَا مُنَاقَشَةِ الْحِسَابِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ مُقْبِلًا عَلَيْنَا وَلَا تَجْعَلْهُ غَاضِبًا عَلَيْنَا.
options: O Allah, gladden us with him in the courtyards of Resurrection, and make him for us a guide to the Garden of Bliss without hardship, without difficulty, and without a searching reckoning, and make him well-disposed toward us, and do not make him angry with us.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the clouds flowing between the sky and the earth and the waters they rain down, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the winds made subservient in the east and west of the earth, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the stars of the sky, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You created in Your seas of fish, creatures, waters, sands, and other than that.

O Allah, I ask You by the Great Names, those I know of them and those I do not know, and by the names by which You have named Yourself, those I know of them and those I do not know, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your prophet, and Your messenger, as many as You created before the sky was built, the earth spread out, the mountains anchored, the springs made to burst forth, the rivers made to pour down, the sun made to rise, the moon made luminous, the stars made radiant, the seas made to flow, and the trees made to bear fruit.
O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant and Your messenger, and send blessings upon the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women.

exercises.prompt: وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِوَالِدَيْنَا وَلِجَمِيعِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ، وَآخِرُ دَعْوَانَا أَنِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
options: And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as my words, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the verses of the Quran and its letters, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as those who bless him and as many as those who do not, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family filling Your earth, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the Pen has recorded in the Mother of the Book.
And forgive us and our parents and all the Muslims, the living among them and the dead, and the last of our prayer is that all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You created in Your seven heavens of angels, and as many as what You created in Your earth of jinn, humans, and other than them of wild beasts and birds, and as many as what the Pen has recorded in the knowledge of Your unseen and what it will record until the Day of Resurrection, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the drops and the rain.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family, as many as Your knowledge encompasses and Your Book has counted and Your angels have witnessed, an enduring blessing that endures as long as the dominion of Allah endures.
exercises.translit: Waghfir lana wa li-walidayna wa li-jami'il-muslimina-l-ahya'i minhum wal-amwat, wa akhiru da'wana anil-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin.

exercises.native: وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِوَالِدَيْنَا وَلِجَمِيعِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ، وَآخِرُ دَعْوَانَا أَنِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
options: And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as what You created in Your seven heavens, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as what You will create in them until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the drops of rain and every drop that has fallen from Your sky to Your earth from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.
And forgive us and our parents and all the Muslims, the living among them and the dead, and the last of our prayer is that all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim, and bless our master Muhammad just as You blessed our master Ibrahim. O Allah, place Your blessings and Your benedictions upon our master Muhammad just as You placed them upon our master Ibrahim and upon the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
And I ask You by Your Greatest Name by which You have named Yourself, and I ask You by the right of all Your Names, those I know of them and those I do not know.

exercises.prompt: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ.
options: O Allah, my Lord, convey to him from us the best of greetings, and reward him on our behalf with the best that You have rewarded any prophet on behalf of his nation, O Lord of the worlds.
And forgive us and our parents and all the Muslims, the living among them and the dead, and the last of our prayer is that all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
So I ask You, O Allah, O Allah, O Living, O Eternal, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor: there is no god except You. Glory be to You! Surely I have been a wrong-doer.

I ask You to send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon all the prophets and messengers, and O You who granted our master Muhammad, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, intercession and the elevated rank, to forgive me my sins and cover all my faults and grant me refuge from the Fire.
exercises.translit: Fa-as'aluka ya Allahu ya Allahu ya Hayyu ya Qayyumu ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram, la ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.

exercises.native: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ.
options: So I ask You, O Allah, O Allah, O Living, O Eternal, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor: there is no god except You. Glory be to You! Surely I have been a wrong-doer.
And forgive us and our parents and all the Muslims, the living among them and the dead, and the last of our prayer is that all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

I ask You by what Your Chair bears of Your greatness, Your majesty, Your splendor, Your power, and Your dominion, and by the right of Your treasured, hidden, purified Names which none of Your creation has been shown, and by the right of the Name which You placed upon the night and it grew dark, and upon the day and it shone with light, and upon the heavens and they became lifted.

And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the vegetation and the pebbles, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the ants, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the fresh waters and the salty waters, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your favor upon all Your creation, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad to the extent that You love and are pleased with him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad to the extent that he loves You and is pleased with You.

exercises.prompt: أَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا حَمَلَ كُرْسِيُّكَ مِنْ عَظَمَتِكَ وَجَلَالِكَ وَبَهَائِكَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ وَسُلْطَانِكَ، وَبِحَقِّ أَسْمَائِكَ الْمَخْزُونَةِ الْمَكْنُونَةِ الْمُطَهَّرَةِ الَّتِي لَمْ يَطَّلِعْ عَلَيْهَا أَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَبِحَقِّ الِاسْمِ الَّذِي وَضَعْتَهُ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ فَأَظْلَمَ وَعَلَى النَّهَارِ فَاسْتَنَارَ وَعَلَى السَّمَاوَاتِ فَاسْتَقَلَّتْ.
options: So I ask You, O Allah, O Allah, O Living, O Eternal, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor: there is no god except You. Glory be to You! Surely I have been a wrong-doer.

O Allah, Lord of the souls and the decayed bodies, I ask You by the obedience of the souls returning to their bodies, and by the obedience of the bodies rejoined with their veins by Your words penetrating within them, to place light in my sight, and Your remembrance upon my tongue by night and by day, and grant me righteous deeds.

And to accept from me my deeds, and to pardon what Your knowledge encompasses of my errors, my forgetfulness, and my slips, and to bring me to the utmost of my hope in visiting his grave and greeting him and his two companions with peace, by Your grace, Your favor, Your generosity, and Your bounty, O Kind, O Merciful, O Protector.

I ask You by what Your Chair bears of Your greatness, Your majesty, Your splendor, Your power, and Your dominion, and by the right of Your treasured, hidden, purified Names which none of Your creation has been shown, and by the right of the Name which You placed upon the night and it grew dark, and upon the day and it shone with light, and upon the heavens and they became lifted.
exercises.translit: As'aluka bima hamala kursiyyuka min 'azamatika wa jalalika wa baha'ika wa qudratika wa sultanik, wa bi-haqqi asma'ikal-makhzunatil-maknunatil-mutahharatil-lati lam yattali' 'alayha ahadun min khalqik, wa bi-haqqil-ismil-ladhi wadha'tahu 'alal-layli fa-azlam wa 'alan-nahari fastanara wa 'alas-samawati fastaqallat.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim, and bless our master Muhammad just as You blessed our master Ibrahim. O Allah, place Your blessings and Your benedictions upon our master Muhammad just as You placed them upon our master Ibrahim and upon the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

O You who said, and Your word is the truth: 'And Allah created you and what you do.' And no word, no deed, no movement, and no stillness proceeds from any of His servants except that it has already preceded in His knowledge, His decree, and His measure. I ask You to grant me and everyone who loves him and follows him his intercession and his companionship on the Day of Reckoning.

I ask You by what Your Chair bears of Your greatness, Your majesty, Your splendor, Your power, and Your dominion, and by the right of Your treasured, hidden, purified Names which none of Your creation has been shown, and by the right of the Name which You placed upon the night and it grew dark, and upon the day and it shone with light, and upon the heavens and they became lifted.

exercises.prompt: وَعَلَى الْأَرْضِ فَاسْتَقَرَّتْ، وَعَلَى الْبِحَارِ فَانْفَجَرَتْ، وَعَلَى الْعُيُونِ فَنَبَعَتْ، وَعَلَى السَّحَابِ فَأَمْطَرَتْ. وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ فِي جَبْهَةِ سَيِّدِنَا جِبْرِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ فِي جَبْهَةِ سَيِّدِنَا إِسْرَافِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ حَوْلَ الْعَرْشِ وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ حَوْلَ الْكُرْسِيِّ.
options: And upon the earth and it became settled, and upon the seas and they burst forth, and upon the springs and they gushed, and upon the clouds and they rained. And I ask You by the names written on the brow of our master Jibril, peace be upon him, and by the names written on the brow of our master Israfil, peace be upon him, and upon all the angels, and I ask You by the names written around the Throne and by the names written around the Chair.

O Allah, I ask You by the Great Names, those I know of them and those I do not know, and by the names by which You have named Yourself, those I know of them and those I do not know, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your prophet, and Your messenger, as many as You created before the sky was built, the earth spread out, the mountains anchored, the springs made to burst forth, the rivers made to pour down, the sun made to rise, the moon made luminous, the stars made radiant, the seas made to flow, and the trees made to bear fruit.

O Allah, magnify his standing, make manifest his proof, make clear his argument, make plain his excellence, and accept his intercession for his nation, and employ us by his way, O Lord of the worlds, O Lord of the Great Throne. O Allah, my Lord, gather us in his company and beneath his banner, and give us to drink from his cup, and benefit us through love of him. Amen, O Lord of the worlds.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your knowledge, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your forbearance, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your words, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your favor, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your generosity, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your heavens, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your earth.
exercises.translit: Wa 'alal-ardhi fastaqarrat, wa 'alal-bihari fanfajarat, wa 'alal-'uyuni fanaba'at, wa 'alas-sahabi fa-amtarat. Wa as'aluka bil-asma'il-maktubati fi jabhati Sayyidina Jibrila 'alayhis-salam, wa bil-asma'il-maktubati fi jabhati Sayyidina Israfila 'alayhis-salamu wa 'ala jami'il-mala'ikah, wa as'aluka bil-asma'il-maktubati hawlal-'arshi wa bil-asma'il-maktubati hawlal-kursiyy.

exercises.native: وَعَلَى الْأَرْضِ فَاسْتَقَرَّتْ، وَعَلَى الْبِحَارِ فَانْفَجَرَتْ، وَعَلَى الْعُيُونِ فَنَبَعَتْ، وَعَلَى السَّحَابِ فَأَمْطَرَتْ. وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ فِي جَبْهَةِ سَيِّدِنَا جِبْرِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ فِي جَبْهَةِ سَيِّدِنَا إِسْرَافِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ حَوْلَ الْعَرْشِ وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ حَوْلَ الْكُرْسِيِّ.
options: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the vegetation and the pebbles, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the ants, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the fresh waters and the salty waters, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your favor upon all Your creation, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad to the extent that You love and are pleased with him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad to the extent that he loves You and is pleased with You.

I ask You to send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon all the prophets and messengers, and O You who granted our master Muhammad, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, intercession and the elevated rank, to forgive me my sins and cover all my faults and grant me refuge from the Fire.

O Allah, magnify his standing, make manifest his proof, make clear his argument, make plain his excellence, and accept his intercession for his nation, and employ us by his way, O Lord of the worlds, O Lord of the Great Throne. O Allah, my Lord, gather us in his company and beneath his banner, and give us to drink from his cup, and benefit us through love of him. Amen, O Lord of the worlds.

And upon the earth and it became settled, and upon the seas and they burst forth, and upon the springs and they gushed, and upon the clouds and they rained. And I ask You by the names written on the brow of our master Jibril, peace be upon him, and by the names written on the brow of our master Israfil, peace be upon him, and upon all the angels, and I ask You by the names written around the Throne and by the names written around the Chair.

exercises.prompt: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْأَعْظَمِ الَّذِي سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ أَسْمَائِكَ كُلِّهَا، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ.

And I ask You by Your Greatest Name by which You have named Yourself, and I ask You by the right of all Your Names, those I know of them and those I do not know.

O Allah, Lord of the souls and the decayed bodies, I ask You by the obedience of the souls returning to their bodies, and by the obedience of the bodies rejoined with their veins by Your words penetrating within them, to place light in my sight, and Your remembrance upon my tongue by night and by day, and grant me righteous deeds.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the clouds flowing between the sky and the earth and the waters they rain down, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the winds made subservient in the east and west of the earth, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the stars of the sky, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You created in Your seas of fish, creatures, waters, sands, and other than that.
exercises.translit: Wa as'aluka bismikal-a'zamil-ladhi sammayta bihi nafsak, wa as'aluka bi-haqqi asma'ika kulliha, ma 'alimtu minha wa ma lam a'lam.

exercises.prompt: يَا مَنْ قَالَ وَقَوْلُهُ الْحَقُّ: ﴿وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ﴾، وَلَا يَصْدُرُ عَنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْ عَبِيدِهِ قَوْلٌ وَلَا فِعْلٌ وَلَا حَرَكَةٌ وَلَا سُكُونٌ إِلَّا وَقَدْ سَبَقَ فِي عِلْمِهِ وَقَضَائِهِ وَقَدَرِهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَرْزُقَنِي وَكُلَّ مَنْ أَحَبَّهُ وَاتَّبَعَهُ شَفَاعَتَهُ وَمُرَافَقَتَهُ يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ.
options: O You who said, and Your word is the truth: 'And Allah created you and what you do.' And no word, no deed, no movement, and no stillness proceeds from any of His servants except that it has already preceded in His knowledge, His decree, and His measure. I ask You to grant me and everyone who loves him and follows him his intercession and his companionship on the Day of Reckoning.

And O You who returned Musa to his mother, and O You who increased our master al-Khidr in his knowledge, and O You who granted our master Dawud our master Sulayman, and our master Zakariya our master Yahya, and our lady Maryam our master 'Isa, and O Protector of the daughter of our master Shu'ayb.
And forgive us and our parents and all the Muslims, the living among them and the dead, and the last of our prayer is that all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant and Your messenger, and send blessings upon the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women.
exercises.translit: Ya man qala wa qawluhul-haqq: wallahu khalaqakum wa ma ta'malun, wa la yasduru 'an ahadin min 'abidihi qawlun wa la fi'lun wa la harakatun wa la sukunun illa wa qad sabaqa fi 'ilmihi wa qadha'ihi wa qadarih, as'aluka an tarzuqani wa kulla man ahabbahu wattaba'ahu shafa'atahu wa murafaqatahu yawmal-hisab.

options: O Allah, O You who granted our master Adam our master Sheeth, and granted our master Ibrahim our master Isma'il and our master Ishaq, and returned our master Yusuf to our master Ya'qub, and O You who removed the affliction from our master Ayyub.

O Allah, I ask You, for indeed You are my Master, my Lord, my Protector, my confidence, and my hope, I ask You by the sanctity of the sacred month, the sacred city, the sacred site, and the grave of Your Prophet, peace be upon him, to grant me of the good that none knows except You, and to turn away from me the evil that none knows except You.
And to forgive me my sins and cover my faults, O Bestower, O Forgiver, and to bless me with looking upon Your noble Face among the beloved ones on the Day of Increase and Reward.

O You who said, and Your word is the truth: 'And Allah created you and what you do.' And no word, no deed, no movement, and no stillness proceeds from any of His servants except that it has already preceded in His knowledge, His decree, and His measure. I ask You to grant me and everyone who loves him and follows him his intercession and his companionship on the Day of Reckoning.

exercises.prompt: وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَتَسْتُرَ عُيُوبِي يَا وَهَّابُ يَا غَفَّارُ، وَأَنْ تُنَعِّمَنِي بِالنَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ فِي جُمْلَةِ الْأَحْبَابِ يَوْمَ الْمَزِيدِ وَالثَّوَابِ.
options: And to forgive me my sins and cover my faults, O Bestower, O Forgiver, and to bless me with looking upon Your noble Face among the beloved ones on the Day of Increase and Reward.

O Allah, my Lord, I ask You to forgive me, have mercy on me, accept my repentance, and grant me well-being from every trial and affliction that comes from the earth or descends from the sky, indeed You have power over all things, by Your mercy; and to forgive the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead.

And to accept from me my deeds, and to pardon what Your knowledge encompasses of my errors, my forgetfulness, and my slips, and to bring me to the utmost of my hope in visiting his grave and greeting him and his two companions with peace, by Your grace, Your favor, Your generosity, and Your bounty, O Kind, O Merciful, O Protector.
And I ask You by Your Greatest Name by which You have named Yourself, and I ask You by the right of all Your Names, those I know of them and those I do not know.
exercises.translit: Wa an taghfira li dhunubi wa tastura 'uyubi ya Wahhabu ya Ghaffar, wa an tuna'imani bin-nazri ila wajhikal-karimi fi jumlatil-ahbabi yawmal-mazidi wath-thawab.

exercises.native: وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَتَسْتُرَ عُيُوبِي يَا وَهَّابُ يَا غَفَّارُ، وَأَنْ تُنَعِّمَنِي بِالنَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ فِي جُمْلَةِ الْأَحْبَابِ يَوْمَ الْمَزِيدِ وَالثَّوَابِ.
options: And to forgive me my sins and cover my faults, O Bestower, O Forgiver, and to bless me with looking upon Your noble Face among the beloved ones on the Day of Increase and Reward.

And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as my words, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the verses of the Quran and its letters, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as those who bless him and as many as those who do not, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family filling Your earth, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the Pen has recorded in the Mother of the Book.

And upon the earth and it became settled, and upon the seas and they burst forth, and upon the springs and they gushed, and upon the clouds and they rained. And I ask You by the names written on the brow of our master Jibril, peace be upon him, and by the names written on the brow of our master Israfil, peace be upon him, and upon all the angels, and I ask You by the names written around the Throne and by the names written around the Chair.

And I ask You, O Allah, by the right of what I have sworn to You by, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as You created before the sky was built, the earth spread out, the mountains raised, the springs made to burst forth, the seas made subservient, the rivers made to pour down, the sun made to shine, the moon made luminous, and the star made radiant, and none knows where You are except You.

exercises.prompt: وَأَنْ تَتَقَبَّلَ مِنِّي عَمَلِي، وَأَنْ تَعْفُوَ عَمَّا أَحَاطَ عِلْمُكَ بِهِ مِنْ خَطِيئَتِي وَنِسْيَانِي وَزَلَلِي، وَأَنْ تُبَلِّغَنِي مِنْ زِيَارَةِ قَبْرِهِ وَالتَّسْلِيمِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى صَاحِبَيْهِ غَايَةَ أَمَلِي، بِمَنِّكَ وَفَضْلِكَ وَجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ يَا رَؤُوفُ يَا رَحِيمُ يَا وَلِيُّ.
options: And I ask You by the names by which our master Adam called upon You, peace be upon him, and by which our master Nuh, our master Salih, our master Ya'qub, our master Yusuf, our master Yunus, our master Musa, our master Harun, and our master Shu'ayb called upon You, peace be upon them.
So I ask You, O Allah, O Allah, O Living, O Eternal, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor: there is no god except You. Glory be to You! Surely I have been a wrong-doer.

And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the mountains, the sands, and the pebbles, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the trees and their leaves and the clods of earth and their weights, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as every year and what You create in it and what dies in it, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You create every day and what dies in it until the Day of Resurrection.

And to accept from me my deeds, and to pardon what Your knowledge encompasses of my errors, my forgetfulness, and my slips, and to bring me to the utmost of my hope in visiting his grave and greeting him and his two companions with peace, by Your grace, Your favor, Your generosity, and Your bounty, O Kind, O Merciful, O Protector.
exercises.translit: Wa an tataqabbala minni 'amali, wa an ta'fuwa 'amma ahata 'ilmuka bihi min khati'ati wa nisyani wa zalali, wa an tuballighani min ziyarati qabrihi wat-taslimi 'alayhi wa 'ala sahibayhi ghayata amali, bi-mannika wa fadhlika wa judika wa karamika ya Ra'ufu ya Rahimu ya Waliyy.

options: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant and Your messenger, and send blessings upon the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women.

And to accept from me my deeds, and to pardon what Your knowledge encompasses of my errors, my forgetfulness, and my slips, and to bring me to the utmost of my hope in visiting his grave and greeting him and his two companions with peace, by Your grace, Your favor, Your generosity, and Your bounty, O Kind, O Merciful, O Protector.

I ask You by what Your Chair bears of Your greatness, Your majesty, Your splendor, Your power, and Your dominion, and by the right of Your treasured, hidden, purified Names which none of Your creation has been shown, and by the right of the Name which You placed upon the night and it grew dark, and upon the day and it shone with light, and upon the heavens and they became lifted.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, and the elevated rank, and raise him to the Praised Station which You promised him. Indeed You do not break Your promise.

pairs.native: يَا مَنْ قَالَ وَقَوْلُهُ الْحَقُّ: ﴿وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ﴾، وَلَا يَصْدُرُ عَنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْ عَبِيدِهِ قَوْلٌ وَلَا فِعْلٌ وَلَا حَرَكَةٌ وَلَا سُكُونٌ إِلَّا وَقَدْ سَبَقَ فِي عِلْمِهِ وَقَضَائِهِ وَقَدَرِهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَرْزُقَنِي وَكُلَّ مَنْ أَحَبَّهُ وَاتَّبَعَهُ شَفَاعَتَهُ وَمُرَافَقَتَهُ يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ.
pairs.en: O You who said, and Your word is the truth: 'And Allah created you and what you do.' And no word, no deed, no movement, and no stillness proceeds from any of His servants except that it has already preceded in His knowledge, His decree, and His measure. I ask You to grant me and everyone who loves him and follows him his intercession and his companionship on the Day of Reckoning.
