exercises.prompt: وَأَنْ تُجَازِيَهُ عَنِّي وَعَنْ كُلِّ مَنْ آمَنَ بِهِ وَاتَّبَعَهُ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ أَفْضَلَ وَأَتَمَّ وَأَعَمَّ مَا جَازَيْتَ بِهِ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، يَا قَوِيُّ يَا عَزِيزُ يَا عَلِيُّ.
options: O Allah, gladden us with him in the courtyards of Resurrection, and make him for us a guide to the Garden of Bliss without hardship, without difficulty, and without a searching reckoning, and make him well-disposed toward us, and do not make him angry with us.

And to reward him on my behalf and on behalf of everyone who believed in him and followed him among the Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead, with the best, most complete, and most comprehensive reward You have given anyone of Your creation, O Strong, O Mighty, O Most High.

And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the vegetation and the pebbles, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the ants, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the fresh waters and the salty waters, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your favor upon all Your creation, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad to the extent that You love and are pleased with him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad to the extent that he loves You and is pleased with You.

O Allah, O You who granted our master Adam our master Sheeth, and granted our master Ibrahim our master Isma'il and our master Ishaq, and returned our master Yusuf to our master Ya'qub, and O You who removed the affliction from our master Ayyub.
exercises.translit: Wa an tujaziyahu 'anni wa 'an kulli man amana bihi wattaba'ahu minal-muslimina wal-muslimatil-ahya'i minhum wal-amwati afdhala wa atamma wa a'amma ma jazayta bihi ahadan min khalqika, ya Qawiyyu ya 'Azizu ya 'Aliyy.

exercises.native: وَأَنْ تُجَازِيَهُ عَنِّي وَعَنْ كُلِّ مَنْ آمَنَ بِهِ وَاتَّبَعَهُ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ أَفْضَلَ وَأَتَمَّ وَأَعَمَّ مَا جَازَيْتَ بِهِ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، يَا قَوِيُّ يَا عَزِيزُ يَا عَلِيُّ.
options: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You created in Your seven heavens of angels, and as many as what You created in Your earth of jinn, humans, and other than them of wild beasts and birds, and as many as what the Pen has recorded in the knowledge of Your unseen and what it will record until the Day of Resurrection, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the drops and the rain.

O Allah, I ask You, for indeed You are my Master, my Lord, my Protector, my confidence, and my hope, I ask You by the sanctity of the sacred month, the sacred city, the sacred site, and the grave of Your Prophet, peace be upon him, to grant me of the good that none knows except You, and to turn away from me the evil that none knows except You.

O Allah, I ask You by the Great Names, those I know of them and those I do not know, and by the names by which You have named Yourself, those I know of them and those I do not know, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Your prophet, and Your messenger, as many as You created before the sky was built, the earth spread out, the mountains anchored, the springs made to burst forth, the rivers made to pour down, the sun made to rise, the moon made luminous, the stars made radiant, the seas made to flow, and the trees made to bear fruit.

And to reward him on my behalf and on behalf of everyone who believed in him and followed him among the Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead, with the best, most complete, and most comprehensive reward You have given anyone of Your creation, O Strong, O Mighty, O Most High.

exercises.prompt: وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ مَا أَقْسَمْتُ بِهِ عَلَيْكَ، أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَكُونَ السَّمَاءُ مَبْنِيَّةً وَالْأَرْضُ مَدْحِيَّةً وَالْجِبَالُ عُلْوِيَّةً وَالْعُيُونُ مُنْفَجِرَةً وَالْبِحَارُ مُسَخَّرَةً وَالْأَنْهَارُ مُنْهَمِرَةً وَالشَّمْسُ مُضِيئَةً وَالْقَمَرُ مُضِيئًا وَالنَّجْمُ مُنِيرًا، وَلَا يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ حَيْثُ تَكُونُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
options: And I ask You, O Allah, by the right of what I have sworn to You by, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as You created before the sky was built, the earth spread out, the mountains raised, the springs made to burst forth, the seas made subservient, the rivers made to pour down, the sun made to shine, the moon made luminous, and the star made radiant, and none knows where You are except You.

And to reward him on my behalf and on behalf of everyone who believed in him and followed him among the Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead, with the best, most complete, and most comprehensive reward You have given anyone of Your creation, O Strong, O Mighty, O Most High.
And to forgive me my sins and cover my faults, O Bestower, O Forgiver, and to bless me with looking upon Your noble Face among the beloved ones on the Day of Increase and Reward.
O Allah, my Lord, convey to him from us the best of greetings, and reward him on our behalf with the best that You have rewarded any prophet on behalf of his nation, O Lord of the worlds.
exercises.translit: Wa as'alukallahumma bi-haqqi ma aqsamtu bihi 'alayk, an tusalliya 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin 'adada ma khalaqta min qabli an takunas-sama'u mabniyyatan wal-ardhu madhiyyatan wal-jibalu 'ulwiyyatan wal-'uyunu munfajiratan wal-biharu musakharatan wal-anharu munhamiratan wash-shamsu mudhi'atan wal-qamaru mudhi'an wan-najmu muniran, wa la ya'lamu ahadun haythu takunu illa ant.

exercises.native: وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ مَا أَقْسَمْتُ بِهِ عَلَيْكَ، أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَكُونَ السَّمَاءُ مَبْنِيَّةً وَالْأَرْضُ مَدْحِيَّةً وَالْجِبَالُ عُلْوِيَّةً وَالْعُيُونُ مُنْفَجِرَةً وَالْبِحَارُ مُسَخَّرَةً وَالْأَنْهَارُ مُنْهَمِرَةً وَالشَّمْسُ مُضِيئَةً وَالْقَمَرُ مُضِيئًا وَالنَّجْمُ مُنِيرًا، وَلَا يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ حَيْثُ تَكُونُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
options: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your knowledge, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your forbearance, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your words, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your favor, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your generosity, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your heavens, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as Your earth.

And our master Ibrahim, our master Isma'il, our master Dawud, our master Sulayman, our master Zakariya, our master Yahya, our master Yusha', our master al-Khidr, our master Ilyas, our master al-Yasa', our master Dhul-Kifl, our master 'Isa, and our master Muhammad, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, Your prophet, Your messenger, Your beloved, and Your chosen one.
So I ask You, O Allah, O Allah, O Living, O Eternal, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor: there is no god except You. Glory be to You! Surely I have been a wrong-doer.

And I ask You, O Allah, by the right of what I have sworn to You by, to send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as You created before the sky was built, the earth spread out, the mountains raised, the springs made to burst forth, the seas made subservient, the rivers made to pour down, the sun made to shine, the moon made luminous, and the star made radiant, and none knows where You are except You.

exercises.prompt: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ كَلَامِي، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ آيَاتِ الْقُرْآنِ وَحُرُوفِهِ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَنْ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ وَعَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ مِلْءَ أَرْضِكَ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَا جَرَى بِهِ الْقَلَمُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ.
options: And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as what You created in Your seven heavens, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as what You will create in them until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the drops of rain and every drop that has fallen from Your sky to Your earth from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.

And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as my words, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the verses of the Quran and its letters, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as those who bless him and as many as those who do not, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family filling Your earth, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the Pen has recorded in the Mother of the Book.
O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant and Your messenger, and send blessings upon the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women.

And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as those who praise You, thank You, declare Your Oneness, and glorify You, and who witness that You are Allah, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many times as You and Your angels have blessed him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as those of Your creation who have blessed him and as many as those of Your creation who have not.
exercises.translit: Wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi 'adada kalami, wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi 'adada ayatil-qur'ani wa hurufih, wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi 'adada man yusalli 'alayhi wa 'adada man lam yusalli 'alayh, wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi mil'a ardhik, wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi 'adada ma jara bihil-qalamu fi ummil-kitab.

exercises.native: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ كَلَامِي، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ آيَاتِ الْقُرْآنِ وَحُرُوفِهِ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَنْ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ وَعَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ مِلْءَ أَرْضِكَ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَا جَرَى بِهِ الْقَلَمُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ.
options: And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as my words, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the verses of the Quran and its letters, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as those who bless him and as many as those who do not, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family filling Your earth, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the Pen has recorded in the Mother of the Book.

O Allah, gladden us with him in the courtyards of Resurrection, and make him for us a guide to the Garden of Bliss without hardship, without difficulty, and without a searching reckoning, and make him well-disposed toward us, and do not make him angry with us.

O Allah, Lord of the souls and the decayed bodies, I ask You by the obedience of the souls returning to their bodies, and by the obedience of the bodies rejoined with their veins by Your words penetrating within them, to place light in my sight, and Your remembrance upon my tongue by night and by day, and grant me righteous deeds.

And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as what You created in Your seven heavens of angels, and as many as what You created in Your earth of jinn, humans, and other than them of wild beasts and birds, and as many as what the Pen has recorded in the knowledge of Your unseen and what it will record until the Day of Resurrection, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as the drops and the rain.

exercises.prompt: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي سَبْعِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ فِيهِنَّ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ قَطْرِ الْمَطَرِ وَكُلِّ قَطْرَةٍ قَطَرَتْ مِنْ سَمَائِكَ إِلَى أَرْضِكَ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
options: And forgive us and our parents and all the Muslims, the living among them and the dead, and the last of our prayer is that all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
And to forgive me my sins and cover my faults, O Bestower, O Forgiver, and to bless me with looking upon Your noble Face among the beloved ones on the Day of Increase and Reward.

I ask You by what Your Chair bears of Your greatness, Your majesty, Your splendor, Your power, and Your dominion, and by the right of Your treasured, hidden, purified Names which none of Your creation has been shown, and by the right of the Name which You placed upon the night and it grew dark, and upon the day and it shone with light, and upon the heavens and they became lifted.

And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as what You created in Your seven heavens, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as what You will create in them until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the drops of rain and every drop that has fallen from Your sky to Your earth from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.
exercises.translit: Wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi 'adada ma khalaqta fi sab'i samawatik, wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi 'adada ma anta khaliquhu fihinna ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah, wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi 'adada qatril-matari wa kulli qatratin qatarat min sama'ika ila ardhika min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

options: So I ask You, O Allah, O Allah, O Living, O Eternal, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor: there is no god except You. Glory be to You! Surely I have been a wrong-doer.
And forgive us and our parents and all the Muslims, the living among them and the dead, and the last of our prayer is that all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as what You created in Your seven heavens, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as what You will create in them until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day, and to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as the drops of rain and every drop that has fallen from Your sky to Your earth from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.

O You who said, and Your word is the truth: 'And Allah created you and what you do.' And no word, no deed, no movement, and no stillness proceeds from any of His servants except that it has already preceded in His knowledge, His decree, and His measure. I ask You to grant me and everyone who loves him and follows him his intercession and his companionship on the Day of Reckoning.

exercises.prompt: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَنْ سَبَّحَكَ وَقَدَّسَكَ وَسَجَدَ لَكَ وَعَظَّمَكَ، وَعَدَدَ كُلِّ سَنَةٍ خَلَقْتَهُمْ فِيهَا، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ، وَعَدَدَ السَّحَابِ الْجَارِيَةِ وَالرِّيَاحِ الذَّارِيَةِ.
options: And as many as Your creation, and to the extent of Your own pleasure, and the weight of Your Throne, and the ink of Your words, and to grant him the wasila, the excellence, the elevated rank, the frequented Pool, the Praised Station, and the extended honor, and to magnify his proof, honor his structure, and raise his standing.

And to accept our repentance and grant us well-being from every trial and affliction and tribulation, what is apparent of it and what is hidden, and to have mercy on us and pardon us, and forgive us and all the believing men and women and Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead, and all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

And as many as what the winds have stirred and moved of branches, trees, leaves, fruits, and flowers, and as many as what You created upon the settled part of Your earth and between Your heavens, and as many as the waves of the seas, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.

And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as those who glorified You, sanctified You, prostrated to You, and magnified You, and as many as every year You created them in, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day, and as many as the flowing clouds and the scattering winds.
exercises.translit: Wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi 'adada man sabbahaka wa qaddasaka wa sajada laka wa 'azzamak, wa 'adada kulli sanatin khalaqtahum fiha, min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah, wa 'adadas-sahabil-jariyati war-riyahidh-dhariyah.

exercises.native: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَنْ سَبَّحَكَ وَقَدَّسَكَ وَسَجَدَ لَكَ وَعَظَّمَكَ، وَعَدَدَ كُلِّ سَنَةٍ خَلَقْتَهُمْ فِيهَا، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ، وَعَدَدَ السَّحَابِ الْجَارِيَةِ وَالرِّيَاحِ الذَّارِيَةِ.
options: And as many as the sand and pebbles and every stone and clod You created in the east and west of the earth, its plains, its mountains, and its valleys, and as many as the plants of the earth in its south and north, its east and west, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.

And as many as the flight of jinn and the flapping of humans, and as many as every creature You created upon Your earth, small or large, in the east and west of the earth, of what is known and what none knows except You, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.

And as many as Your creation, and to the extent of Your own pleasure, and the weight of Your Throne, and the ink of Your words, and to grant him the wasila, the excellence, the elevated rank, the frequented Pool, the Praised Station, and the extended honor, and to magnify his proof, honor his structure, and raise his standing.

And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as those who glorified You, sanctified You, prostrated to You, and magnified You, and as many as every year You created them in, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day, and as many as the flowing clouds and the scattering winds.

options: And as many as what the winds have stirred and moved of branches, trees, leaves, fruits, and flowers, and as many as what You created upon the settled part of Your earth and between Your heavens, and as many as the waves of the seas, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, for as long as the morning dawns, the winds blow, living beings move, morning and evening succeed one another, and bodies and souls are sound.
O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, for as long as the celestial spheres turn, generations pass on, and the angels glorify.

O Allah, just as he bore the burdens of the message, saved creation from ignorance, strove against the people of disbelief and misguidance, called to Your Oneness, and endured hardships in guiding Your servants, so grant him, O Allah, his request, and bring him to what he hopes for, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, and the elevated rank, and raise him to the Praised Station which You promised him. Indeed You do not break Your promise.
exercises.translit: Wa 'adada ma habbat bihir-riyahu wa harrakat minal-aghsani wal-ashjari wal-awraqi wath-thimari wal-azhar, wa 'adada ma khalaqta 'ala qarari ardhika wa ma bayna samawatik, wa 'adada amwajil-bihar, min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

options: And as many as the flight of jinn and the flapping of humans, and as many as every creature You created upon Your earth, small or large, in the east and west of the earth, of what is known and what none knows except You, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.

And as many as what the winds have stirred and moved of branches, trees, leaves, fruits, and flowers, and as many as what You created upon the settled part of Your earth and between Your heavens, and as many as the waves of the seas, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.

O Allah, make us among the followers of his law, characterized by love of him, guided by his guidance, and take our souls upon his way, and do not deprive us of the grace of his intercession, and gather us among his radiant followers and his foremost adherents and the companions of the right hand, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

And as many as what You created of humans, jinn, and devils, and what You will create of them until the Day of Resurrection, and as many as every hair on their bodies, their faces, and their heads, and as many as their breaths, their utterances, and their glances, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.

options: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim, and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad just as You blessed our master Ibrahim, in all the worlds. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

And as many as the flight of jinn and the flapping of humans, and as many as every creature You created upon Your earth, small or large, in the east and west of the earth, of what is known and what none knows except You, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.
And He is sufficient for me, and the best Disposer of affairs. And there is no power and no might except in Allah, the Most High, the Exalted.

And as many as the sand and pebbles and every stone and clod You created in the east and west of the earth, its plains, its mountains, and its valleys, and as many as the plants of the earth in its south and north, its east and west, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.
exercises.translit: Wa 'adadar-ramli wal-hasa wa kulli hajarin wa madarin khalaqtahu fi mashariqil-ardhi wa magharibiha sahliha wa jibaliha wa awdiyatiha, wa 'adada nabatil-ardhi fi qiblatiha wa jawfiha wa sharqiha wa gharbiha, min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, for as long as the morning dawns, the winds blow, living beings move, morning and evening succeed one another, and bodies and souls are sound.

And to send blessings upon him and upon his family in the night when it covers and the day when it appears in glory, and in the last life and the first, from when he was a child in the cradle until he became a guided elder, and You took him to You, a just and pleasing one, that You might raise him as a caring intercessor.
O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, for as long as the celestial spheres turn, generations pass on, and the angels glorify.

exercises.prompt: وَعَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الْإِنْسِ وَالْجِنِّ وَالشَّيَاطِينِ وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ مِنْهُمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَعَدَدَ كُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ فِي أَبْدَانِهِمْ وَوُجُوهِهِمْ وَعَلَى رُءُوسِهِمْ، وَعَدَدَ أَنْفَاسِهِمْ وَأَلْفَاظِهِمْ وَلَحَظَاتِهِمْ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
options: O Allah, just as he bore the burdens of the message, saved creation from ignorance, strove against the people of disbelief and misguidance, called to Your Oneness, and endured hardships in guiding Your servants, so grant him, O Allah, his request, and bring him to what he hopes for, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, and the elevated rank, and raise him to the Praised Station which You promised him. Indeed You do not break Your promise.

And as many as the flight of jinn and the flapping of humans, and as many as every creature You created upon Your earth, small or large, in the east and west of the earth, of what is known and what none knows except You, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.

And as many as what You created of humans, jinn, and devils, and what You will create of them until the Day of Resurrection, and as many as every hair on their bodies, their faces, and their heads, and as many as their breaths, their utterances, and their glances, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, for as long as the doves coo, the pouring rains fall, the grazing beasts roam, the amulets bring benefit, the turbans are wound tight, and the sleepers sleep.
exercises.translit: Wa 'adada ma khalaqta minal-insi wal-jinni wash-shayatini wa ma anta khaliquhu minhum ila yawmil-qiyamah, wa 'adada kulli sha'ratin fi abdanihim wa wujuhihim wa 'ala ru'usihim, wa 'adada anfasihim wa alfazihim wa lahazatihim, min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

exercises.prompt: وَعَدَدَ طَيَرَانِ الْجِنِّ وَخَفَقَانِ الْإِنْسِ، وَعَدَدَ كُلِّ بَهِيمَةٍ خَلَقْتَهَا عَلَى أَرْضِكَ صَغِيرَةً أَوْ كَبِيرَةً فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا مِمَّا عُلِمَ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
options: And He is sufficient for me, and the best Disposer of affairs. And there is no power and no might except in Allah, the Most High, the Exalted.

And to send blessings upon him and upon his family in the night when it covers and the day when it appears in glory, and in the last life and the first, from when he was a child in the cradle until he became a guided elder, and You took him to You, a just and pleasing one, that You might raise him as a caring intercessor.
O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, for as long as the celestial spheres turn, generations pass on, and the angels glorify.

And as many as the flight of jinn and the flapping of humans, and as many as every creature You created upon Your earth, small or large, in the east and west of the earth, of what is known and what none knows except You, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.
exercises.translit: Wa 'adada tayaranil-jinni wa khafaqanil-ins, wa 'adada kulli bahimatin khalaqtaha 'ala ardhika saghiratan aw kabiratan fi mashariqil-ardhi wa magharibiha mimma 'ulima wa mimma la ya'lamu 'ilmahu illa ant, min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

options: And as many as Your creation, and to the extent of Your own pleasure, and the weight of Your Throne, and the ink of Your words, and to grant him the wasila, the excellence, the elevated rank, the frequented Pool, the Praised Station, and the extended honor, and to magnify his proof, honor his structure, and raise his standing.
O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, for as long as the celestial spheres turn, generations pass on, and the angels glorify.

And as many as those who have blessed him and as many as those who have not blessed him and as many as those who will bless him until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day, and as many as the living and the dead, and as many as what You created of fish, birds, ants, bees, and insects.

O Allah, make us among the followers of his law, characterized by love of him, guided by his guidance, and take our souls upon his way, and do not deprive us of the grace of his intercession, and gather us among his radiant followers and his foremost adherents and the companions of the right hand, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
exercises.translit: Wa 'adada man salla 'alayhi wa 'adada man lam yusalli 'alayhi wa 'adada man yusalli 'alayhi ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah, wa 'adadal-ahya'i wal-amwat, wa 'adada ma khalaqta minal-hitani wat-tayri wan-namli wan-nahli wal-hasharat.

exercises.prompt: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ فِي اللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى، وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ وَالْأُولَى، مُنْذُ كَانَ فِي الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا إِلَى أَنْ صَارَ كَهْلًا مَهْدِيًّا، فَقَبَضْتَهُ إِلَيْكَ عَدْلًا مَرْضِيًّا لِتَبْعَثَهُ شَفِيعًا حَفِيًّا.
options: And to accept our repentance and grant us well-being from every trial and affliction and tribulation, what is apparent of it and what is hidden, and to have mercy on us and pardon us, and forgive us and all the believing men and women and Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead, and all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

And to send blessings upon him and upon his family in the night when it covers and the day when it appears in glory, and in the last life and the first, from when he was a child in the cradle until he became a guided elder, and You took him to You, a just and pleasing one, that You might raise him as a caring intercessor.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, for as long as the morning dawns, the winds blow, living beings move, morning and evening succeed one another, and bodies and souls are sound.

And as many as the flight of jinn and the flapping of humans, and as many as every creature You created upon Your earth, small or large, in the east and west of the earth, of what is known and what none knows except You, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.
exercises.translit: Wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi fil-layli idha yaghsha wan-nahari idha tajalla, wa fil-akhirati wal-ula, mundhu kana fil-mahdi sabiyyan ila an sara kahlan mahdiyyan, fa-qabadhtahu ilayka 'adlan mardhiyyan li-tab'athahu shafi'an hafiyyan.

exercises.native: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ فِي اللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى، وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ وَالْأُولَى، مُنْذُ كَانَ فِي الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا إِلَى أَنْ صَارَ كَهْلًا مَهْدِيًّا، فَقَبَضْتَهُ إِلَيْكَ عَدْلًا مَرْضِيًّا لِتَبْعَثَهُ شَفِيعًا حَفِيًّا.
options: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, for as long as the morning dawns, the winds blow, living beings move, morning and evening succeed one another, and bodies and souls are sound.

And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as those who glorified You, sanctified You, prostrated to You, and magnified You, and as many as every year You created them in, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day, and as many as the flowing clouds and the scattering winds.

And as many as the sand and pebbles and every stone and clod You created in the east and west of the earth, its plains, its mountains, and its valleys, and as many as the plants of the earth in its south and north, its east and west, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.

And to send blessings upon him and upon his family in the night when it covers and the day when it appears in glory, and in the last life and the first, from when he was a child in the cradle until he became a guided elder, and You took him to You, a just and pleasing one, that You might raise him as a caring intercessor.

exercises.prompt: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الْكِرَامِ صَلَاةً مَوْصُولَةً دَائِمَةَ الِاتِّصَالِ بِدَوَامِ ذِي الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ.
options: O Allah, send blessings upon our master and prophet Muhammad, a blessing that pleases You and pleases him and through which You are pleased with us, and a blessing by which You protect us from envy and arrogance, and by which You purify our souls from vain desire, and by which You cleanse our hearts of all but You.

O Allah, indeed we have believed in him without having seen him, so grant us in both abodes the enjoyment of seeing him, and steady our hearts upon love of him, and employ us by his way, and take our souls upon his religion, and gather us in his saved company and his successful party, and benefit us by what our hearts have folded within them of love for him, may Allah bless him and grant him peace.

O Allah, indeed we seek intercession through him with You, since he is the most eminent of intercessors with You, and we seek nearness through him to You, since he is the greatest of those by whose right one may swear before You, and we turn through him toward You, since he is the closest of means to You.

exercises.prompt: وَأَوْرِدْنَا حَوْضَهُ الْأَصْفَى، وَاسْقِنَا بِكَأْسِهِ الْأَوْفَى، وَيَسِّرْ عَلَيْنَا زِيَارَةَ حَرَمِكَ وَحَرَمِهِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تُمِيتَنَا، وَأَدِمْ عَلَيْنَا الْإِقَامَةَ بِحَرَمِكَ وَحَرَمِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى أَنْ نَتَوَفَّى.

And bring us to his purest Pool, and give us to drink from his most complete cup, and make it easy for us to visit Your sacred precinct and his before You cause us to die, and make our residence at Your sacred precinct and his, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, endure until we pass away.

pairs.en: And may Allah's blessings be upon our master Muhammad and upon his family and companions, and grant abundant peace, and all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

options: O Allah, send blessings upon our master and prophet Muhammad, a blessing by which You gather us with the prophets and the truthful, and by which You raise us with the martyrs and the righteous, and by which You make heavy our scale, and by which You steady our feet upon the Bridge, and by which You admit us to the Gardens of Bliss without reckoning. So forgive our sins and cover our faults, O Merciful, O Generous, O Forbearing, and have mercy on us, indeed You have power over all things.

And bring us to his purest Pool, and give us to drink from his most complete cup, and make it easy for us to visit Your sacred precinct and his before You cause us to die, and make our residence at Your sacred precinct and his, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, endure until we pass away.
Glory to your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they attribute to Him! And peace be upon the messengers, and all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

I ask You, O Light of Light before the ages and the eras, You are the Everlasting without ceasing, the Self-Sufficient without equal, the Holy, the Pure, the Most High, the Overpowering, whom no place encompasses and no time contains.
exercises.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina wa nabiyyina Muhammadin salatan tahshuruna biha ma'an-nabiyyina was-siddiqin, wa tab'athuna biha ma'ash-shuhada'i was-salihin, wa tuthaqqilu biha mizanana, wa tuthabbitu biha 'alas-sirati aqdamana, wa tudkhiluna biha jannatin-na'imi bila hisab, faghfir dhunubana wastur 'uyubana ya Rahimu ya Karimu ya Halim, warhamna innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.

options: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, a blessing by which You honor his abode and by which You bring him on the Day of Resurrection to his contentment through intercession.

And send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family as many as the people of Paradise and the people of the Fire, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family as many as the righteous and the wicked, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family as many as the alternation of night and day, and make, O Allah, our blessing upon him a shield from the punishment of the Fire and a means to be granted the Abode of Settlement. Indeed You are the Mighty, the Forgiving.

O Allah, I ask You, for I bear witness that You are Allah, there is no god except You, the One, the Only, the Eternal Refuge, who did not beget and was not begotten, and there is none equal to Him. O Allah, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, the Living, the Sustainer, the Judge, the Compassionate, the Bestower.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master and prophet Muhammad, a blessing by which You gather us with the prophets and the truthful, and by which You raise us with the martyrs and the righteous, and by which You make heavy our scale, and by which You steady our feet upon the Bridge, and by which You admit us to the Gardens of Bliss without reckoning. So forgive our sins and cover our faults, O Merciful, O Generous, O Forbearing, and have mercy on us, indeed You have power over all things.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master and prophet Muhammad, a blessing by which You forgive our sins, and cover our faults, and protect us from committing wrongdoings, and grant us success in doing righteous deeds.

exercises.prompt: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ، وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
options: O Allah, indeed we seek intercession through him with You, since he is the most eminent of intercessors with You, and we seek nearness through him to You, since he is the greatest of those by whose right one may swear before You, and we turn through him toward You, since he is the closest of means to You.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, who is the pole of majesty, the sun of prophethood and the message, the guide from misguidance, and the rescuer from ignorance. May Allah bless him and grant him peace with a blessing of continuous and unbroken connection, following one another as the days and nights follow one another.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master and prophet Muhammad, a blessing by which You turn away from us all evil, and grant us by it all good, and set right our states by it, and protect us by it from disobedience and error.
Glory to your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they attribute to Him! And peace be upon the messengers, and all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

exercises.native: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ، وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
options: O Allah, have mercy on our supplication, secure us from our fear, accept our deeds, set right our states, make our occupation Your obedience, and our outcome the good, and make our hopes real through increase of faith, and seal our terms with happiness. This is our lowliness, manifest before You, and our state is not hidden from You, so pardon us, O Best of those hoped in and Most Generous of those asked, indeed You are Forgiving, Merciful, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

O Allah, open our chests by sending blessings upon him, and ease our affairs by it, and relieve our worries by it, and remove our sorrows by it, and forgive our sins by it, and settle our debts by it, and set right our states by it, and bring our hopes to fulfillment by it, and accept our repentance by it, and wash away our sin by it, and support our argument by it, and purify our tongues by it, and comfort our loneliness by it, and have mercy on our estrangement by it.

I ask You, O Light of Light before the ages and the eras, You are the Everlasting without ceasing, the Self-Sufficient without equal, the Holy, the Pure, the Most High, the Overpowering, whom no place encompasses and no time contains.
Glory to your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they attribute to Him! And peace be upon the messengers, and all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
